title: Task times on two control screens
intro: Ten plant operators did the same alarm-response task on the old control screen and on a redesigned one, and the time (s) was recorded for each. One operator was very slow on the old screen (22.8 s), so the ten differences old − new are far from normal. The Wilcoxon signed-rank test ranks the sizes of the differences instead of averaging them, so that one large difference counts as just the largest rank. H₀: the differences are symmetric about 0; H₁: they are not, at α = 0.05.
